name: P. D. O'Brien
bio: P. D. O'Brien, a Deadwood mining broker, came through Medora on the first coach from the Hills in October 1884, bound for Chicago and the east. He passed through again with his wife in January 1885.

moments.label: Came through on the first coach, bound east

mentions: …first coach from the Hills Tuesday evening were: H. H. Chandler, Lieutenant W. D. Wright, P. H. Wilson, P. D. O'Brien and S. B. Segen.
